title: Reachability: UXV (Earth, Mercury and Cygnus X-1 orbit, then Vela pulsar orbit and Cassiopeia A, then the gate)
note: UXV-C1 (docs/eras/uxv.md "Validator", "Gate to OpV", "Bootstrap check"): UIV's pack plus the 21 UXV machines and M2's hall, the two jumps, the UXV wireless tier and the checks of the Validator. Substages: uxv (Earth, Mercury and Cygnus X-1 orbit), uxv-vela and uxv-cas-a (parallel siblings after the Kerr sling), the gate (opv) after both. As built: the emitter takes lasagna plate and the M2 hall's stellar hydrogen cut (Vela) besides Ti-44 (Cas A), so it is checked after both; after the tier-parity retrofit (TP-R) the Mk4 needs Sirius B (gtceu:uev_field_generator takes the degenerate pellet), the Mk5 RX J1856, the droplet radiator works, the polarised proton source and the Matrioshka both UIV siblings, so the inherited groups place them there. Older machines get the UXV-era voltages of their new modes as two-hatch or higher-hatch variants.

eu_to_start.note: The Mk6 ring: 16 UXV hatches store 16 x 2^6 x 10,000,000 = 10,240,000,000 EU (startup uxv/fusion_mk6.js:8); the oxygen burning start needs 10,000,000,000.
